title: RustConf 2016 - A Modern Editor Built in Rust by Raph Levien
summary: Raph Levien presents Xi editor at RustConf 2016, a high-performance text editor built in Rust. The talk goes into technical details, building polished GUI apps, and running a community-focused open source project.
why: HN lists it among good resources on building text editors and as a recommended lunch-and-learn talk.
